results.title: Weighted interval ULC through nine variables
results.statement: For every integer 0<=m<=9, every binary family on m positions defined by arbitrary integer lower/upper bounds on sums over linear intervals, and all nonnegative real position weights, its weighted rank sequence is ultra-log-concave of order m.
results.limits: All dimensions and cycle domination remain open; numerical ULC is not coefficientwise ULC.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified
results.catalog_policy: research result only; canonical resolution ledger unchanged

results.title: All-dimensional endpoint inequalities
results.statement: For every such linear interval family in every integer dimension m>=0 and every nonnegative weight vector, k(m-k)f_k^2 >= (k+1)(m-k+1)f_(k-1)f_(k+1) at k in {1,2,3,4,m-4,m-3,m-2,m-1} intersect {1,...,m-1}.
results.limits: Middle inequalities in dimensions >=10 are not established. Uses Kahn-Neiman Theorem 9.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified
results.catalog_policy: research result only; canonical resolution ledger unchanged

results.title: Laminar interval ULC
results.statement: For every integer m>=0, every laminar family of integer-bounded linear intervals on m binary positions, and all nonnegative position weights, the weighted feasible-word ranks are ULC of order m.
results.limits: Typical overlapping path neighborhoods are not laminar. Convolution closure is published, not claimed new.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified

results.title: Leading cycle Hankel block
results.statement: For every integer r>=2, all nonempty minors of (c_(r,i+j)(x))_(i,j=0)^2 are coefficientwise nonnegative, with positive coefficients throughout each stated nonzero support. The 3x3 determinant has support exactly degrees 2 through 6.
results.limits: Only row and column indices 0,1,2. Universal Hankel TN2 for either family and arbitrary cycle order-three minors remain unproved here.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified
results.catalog_policy: research result only; canonical resolution ledger unchanged

results.title: Uniform interpolation disk through degree five
results.statement: For every integer 1<=n<=5 and every real parameter tuple (a_1,...,a_n) in [0,1]^n, all zeros of P(z)=sum_(j=0)^n e_(n-j)(a) binom(z,j) satisfy |z+1/2|<=n-1/2. Boundary zeros occur only at the all-zero and all-one parameter polynomials. Thus R_n=n for 1<=n<=5.
results.limits: Exact certificate proof uniformly covers parameters, but only degrees through five. Reported degrees six to eight are not recovered.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified
results.catalog_policy: research result only; canonical resolution ledger unchanged

results.title: All-degree equal-parameter interpolation disk
results.statement: For every integer n>=1 and every real a in [0,1], all zeros of the polynomial with L(P)(u)=(u+a)^n satisfy |z+1/2|<=n-1/2, strictly for 0<a<1. For n>=2, |z+1/2|^2 <= (n-1/2)^2-8a(1-a)(n-1).
results.limits: One-parameter family; arbitrary independent parameters in higher degrees remain open.
results.review_status: written argument and exact controls reviewed; not proof-assistant verified

results.title: Degree-dependent s-Eulerian representation bound
results.statement: Every nonconstant s-Eulerian polynomial of integer degree d>=1 has a representing positive integer vector of length at most 2d-1.
results.limits: Existential bound after deleting units and contracting all-two blocks; all-degree sharpness for (1+ux)^d is not recovered.

results.title: Connected quadratic s-Eulerian inequality
results.statement: For every positive integer vector s with all entries >=2, if E_s(x)=1+h_1 x+h_2 x^2 has degree exactly two, then h_1>h_2>0.
results.limits: Degree-two blocks only; does not establish simple roots for every nonunit block. Exceptional (2,6,3) coefficients corrected to (1,19,16).

results.title: Exact uncoloured multiplicity (2,b) classification
results.statement: For every positive integer b, A_(2,b)(x)=1+2b x+binom(b,2)x^2 is s-Eulerian for some positive integer vector of arbitrary length iff b=2 or b(b+1)/2 is an integer square.
results.limits: Exact subfamily of general coloured multiset question Q1262; not full classification.

results.title: One-bit inclusion matching fails
results.statement: In dimension six, equations x1+x2=x2+x3=x4+x5=x5+x6=1 give rank counts (0,0,1,2,1,0,0). The unique rank-two word 010010 has no feasible rank-three superset.
results.limits: Refutes the stated stronger matching route, not APP or ULC. The stalled agent matching definition was not supplied.

results.title: Coefficientwise ULC fails
results.statement: The unrestricted two-variable family has central normalized ULC defect w1^2-2*w1*w2+w2^2, whose mixed coefficient is -2.
results.limits: Numerical nonnegativity survives, since the defect is (w1-w2)^2.

results.title: Arbitrary interpolation shift mixtures violate the disk
results.statement: For n=4, P(z)=binom(z,4)+binom(z+4,4) has a root with |z+1/2|>7/2; 24P(w-1/2)=2w^4+43w^2+105/8.
results.limits: Outside the TP class: sampled numerator 1+t^4 is not real-rooted. Does not refute Q1442.
